summary.text: Robert Davis is a Republican member of the Wyoming House of Representatives, District 47, who is running for the Wyoming State Senate, District 11, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He has served in the House since 2023 and is not seeking re-election to his House seat.

paragraphs.text: Robert Davis was born in Omaha, Nebraska, and lives in Wyoming.
His career experience includes working in the commercial construction business, as a public works director, as a business owner and as a rancher.
Davis has volunteered as a Carbon County commissioner, on the Carbon County Development Board, on the Noyes Health Care Clinic Board, and with the Wyoming Army National Guard 133 Combat Engineers.
Davis assumed office in the Wyoming House on January 2, 2023, succeeding Jerry Paxton, and his current term ends on January 4, 2027.
Ballotpedia's campaign finance records list general election wins for House District 47 in 2022 and 2024.
He advanced from the August 18, 2026 Republican primary for the Senate seat.
